Convert common measure values to numeric values

Source: R/data.R
policy_numbers.Rd

Handles numeric vectors, comma-formatted values, percent signs, missing-value tokens, and cells containing a numeric token plus explanatory text. Percent values are returned in the scale shown: "53.2%" becomes 53.2, not 0.532.

Usage

policy_numbers(x)

Arguments

x

A vector of measure values.

Value

A numeric vector.

Examples

policy_numbers(c("1,240", "53.2%", "score: -4.5", "N/A"))
#> [1] 1240.0   53.2   -4.5     NA
